answer_1.quote: We propose ToneCraft, a novel framework that utilizes Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate Cantonese lyrics while respecting tonal and melodic harmony...
answer_1.outputs: Generated Cantonese lyric strings aligned with a given pitch sequence

answer_2.quote: We evaluate lyric diversity and melody-lyric alignment using several objective metrics. (1) Similarity ... (2) MA-D1/D2 and MI-D1/D2 ... (3) Consistency ... (4) Harmony ...

answer_4.quote: We invited ten native Cantonese speakers as volunteers... They were asked to score the generated lyrics on a scale from 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent) based on the following criteria: Lyric quality considers Diversity, Fluency, Coherence, Poeticness; Lyric-melody alignment is assessed from Harmonicity, Listenability, Ambiguity.
answer_4.guideline: Volunteers rated each sample on a 1‑5 scale for the listed criteria (Diversity, Fluency, Coherence, Poeticness, Harmonicity, Listenability, Ambiguity).
